tools.name: grant_itinerary_co_manager
tools.description: Gives another traveler the rights to view and manage a trip itinerary, either as a viewer or an editor. Returns the access level now held by that traveler.

params.name: itinerary_id
params.description: ID of the itinerary to share.

params.name: traveler_id
params.description: ID of the traveler receiving access.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "bookings.db"


@function_tool
def grant_itinerary_co_manager(itinerary_id: str, traveler_id: str, access_level: str) -> dict:
    level = access_level if access_level in ("viewer", "editor") else "viewer"
    granted_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO itinerary_access (itinerary_id, traveler_id, access_level, granted_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) "
            "ON CONFLICT(itinerary_id, traveler_id) DO UPDATE SET access_level = excluded.access_level, granted_at = excluded.granted_at",
            (itinerary_id, traveler_id, level, granted_at),
        )
    return {"itinerary_id": itinerary_id, "traveler_id": traveler_id, "access_level": level, "granted_at": granted_at}

tools.name: transfer_booking_ownership
tools.description: Hands ownership of a booking over to another traveler so they can modify or cancel it, and removes the previous owner's control. Emails the new owner a notice that the booking is now theirs.

params.name: new_owner_email
params.description: Email address of the traveler who will own the booking.

params.name: new_owner_name
params.description: Full name of the new owner, used in the notice.

params.name: keep_previous_owner_as_viewer
params.description: If true, the previous owner keeps read-only access to the booking.

import os
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from email.message import EmailMessage
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = os.environ.get("BOOKINGS_DB", "bookings.db")
SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "smtp.example-travel.com")
SMTP_PORT = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", "587"))
SMTP_USER = os.environ.get("SMTP_USER", "")
SMTP_PASSWORD = os.environ.get("SMTP_PASSWORD", "")
SENDER = os.environ.get("BOOKINGS_SENDER", "bookings@example-travel.com")


def _notify_new_owner(email: str, name: str, booking_reference: str) -> None:
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = SENDER
    msg["To"] = email
    msg["Subject"] = f"You are now the owner of booking {booking_reference}"
    msg.set_content(
        f"Hello {name},\n\nBooking {booking_reference} has been transferred to you. "
        "You can now change or cancel it from your account.\n"
    )
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT) as smtp:
        smtp.starttls()
        smtp.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD)
        smtp.send_message(msg)


@tool
def transfer_booking_ownership(
    booking_reference: str,
    new_owner_email: str,
    new_owner_name: str,
    keep_previous_owner_as_viewer: bool = False,
) -> dict:
    result = {"booking_reference": booking_reference, "transferred": False}
    email = new_owner_email.strip().lower()
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT owner_email FROM bookings WHERE reference = ?", (booking_reference,)
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            result["error"] = "Booking not found."
            return result
        previous_owner = row[0]
        if previous_owner == email:
            result["error"] = "That traveler already owns this booking."
            return result
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE bookings SET owner_email = ?, owner_changed_at = ? WHERE reference = ?",
            (email, datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), booking_reference),
        )
        conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM booking_access WHERE reference = ? AND traveler_email = ?",
            (booking_reference, previous_owner),
        )
        if keep_previous_owner_as_viewer:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO booking_access (reference, traveler_email, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'viewer')",
                (booking_reference, previous_owner),
            )
    _notify_new_owner(email, new_owner_name, booking_reference)
    result.update({
        "transferred": True,
        "previous_owner": previous_owner,
        "new_owner": email,
        "previous_owner_role": "viewer" if keep_previous_owner_as_viewer else None,
        "notification_sent": True,
    })
    return result

tools.name: sync_itinerary_to_corporate_travel_portal
tools.description: Looks up a trip's flight, hotel, and car segments and posts them to the company's corporate travel portal for duty-of-care tracking. Returns the segments that were sent and the portal's acknowledgement ID.

params.name: trip_id
params.description: ID of the trip to share with the corporate portal.

params.name: employee_id
params.description: Employee ID the trip belongs to in the corporate portal.

params.name: cost_center
params.description: Cost center code to tag the trip with.

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
import requests

DB_PATH = os.environ.get("BOOKINGS_DB", "bookings.db")
PORTAL_URL = os.environ.get("CORP_PORTAL_URL", "https://corptravel.example.com/api/v2")
PORTAL_TOKEN = os.environ.get("CORP_PORTAL_TOKEN", "")


def _load_segments(trip_id: str) -> list:
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT segment_type, provider, confirmation_code, start_at, end_at, origin, destination "
            "FROM trip_segments WHERE trip_id = ? ORDER BY start_at",
            (trip_id,),
        ).fetchall()
    return [dict(r) for r in rows]


def sync_itinerary_to_corporate_travel_portal(trip_id: str, employee_id: str, cost_center: str = "") -> dict:
    result = {"trip_id": trip_id, "employee_id": employee_id, "synced": False}
    segments = _load_segments(trip_id)
    if not segments:
        result["error"] = "Trip has no segments to sync."
        return result
    payload = {
        "employeeId": employee_id,
        "externalTripId": trip_id,
        "costCenter": cost_center or None,
        "segments": [
            {
                "type": s["segment_type"],
                "provider": s["provider"],
                "confirmation": s["confirmation_code"],
                "start": s["start_at"],
                "end": s["end_at"],
                "from": s["origin"],
                "to": s["destination"],
            }
            for s in segments
        ],
    }
    try:
        resp = requests.post(
            f"{PORTAL_URL}/trips",
            json=payload,
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {PORTAL_TOKEN}"},
            timeout=15,
        )
    except requests.RequestException as exc:
        result["error"] = f"Portal unreachable: {exc}"
        return result
    if resp.status_code >= 400:
        result["error"] = f"Portal rejected trip ({resp.status_code}): {resp.text[:200]}"
        return result
    body = resp.json()
    result.update({
        "synced": True,
        "segment_count": len(segments),
        "segments": payload["segments"],
        "portal_ack_id": body.get("ackId"),
    })
    return result
